design.hypothesis: If hard-root failures come from long-context dilution, a 3-sentence evidence excerpt will recover both cells; otherwise the failure is field binding/localisation.
design.rationale: Full-table validation complete; expand coverage on the next unused hard roots.
design.scoring: exact integer match per field; task correct iff both target cells correct

tasks.prompt:
You are a cricket scorer. Read the commentary and return the requested values at the END of the specified innings. Return ONLY a JSON object mapping each field id to its value. Integers for numeric fields, exact names for names, null if not confirmable. No prose.

Match: match_0008
Innings: 2
Fields:
- inn2.total_runs
- inn2.total_wickets

Commentary:
Aiden’s fifty was deserved because he had fought through the only meaningful resistance Ridgeview had, yet it was also isolated. Zane Perry stayed at the end with almost nothing to work with, and Isaac Reed closed the match by trapping Aaron Wells, leaving Ridgeview all out for 157. The final margin of 105 runs says Coral Coast controlled the game, and the flow supports that reading.
